readout_other: Pre/post FLAIR MRI with neuroradiological review and quantitative rFLAIR; Report of Symptoms (17 symptoms); quantitative sensory testing (temporal summation of pain, conditioned pain modulation); tolerability and blinding Likert items
direction_notes: No change in TSP or CPM between LIFU and sham, and no change in FLAIR signal within the stimulated beam volume.
safety_notes: No serious adverse events, no stopping criteria triggered; no new moderate or severe within-visit symptoms. At the 24-72 h follow-up one new moderate headache and one new severe itchiness were reported in single participants and judged not to require intervention. No new edema, microhemorrhage, ischemia or white matter injury on post-LIFU MRI.

exposures.label: Left dorsal anterior insula LIFU, 10 min

timing.protocol_description: LIFU consisted of 100 pulse trains, each lasting 1 second, delivered with a fixed pulse train interval of 5 seconds, for a total neuromodulation duration of 10 minutes (36 s of active sonication). Within each train a 1 kHz, 36% duty cycle gate was applied to a 500 kHz sine wave.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Nineteen participants were enrolled and completed baseline structural MR and CT imaging. One participant was excluded due to inability to complete the required structural MRI, and five were lost to follow-up due to scheduling conflicts or participant unavailability prior to receiving any intervention, yielding a final sample of 13 participants who completed the full experimental protocol
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Participants completed four visits in total: one baseline visit, two intervention visits (one LIFU and one sham), and one dedicated safety imaging visit (see MRI and CT Imaging section).

flags.reason: 19 participants enrolled; 13 completed the protocol and are recorded.
Three transducers used: H-281 (9 participants) and H-104 (3), both Sonic Concepts, and a CTX-500 in one participant (which would be neurofus by the family rule). Recorded the majority maker.
Mean peak intracranial pressure from subject-specific k-Wave simulation (76.1 +/- 25.6 kPa); discussion also quotes 50-125 kPa in-head.
Pulse duration not stated for the in vivo waveform (duty cycle 36% at 1 kHz PRF); not computed.
Sonication duration is the 1 s train; the full session is 100 trains with 5 s intervals.
Order counterbalanced and allocation sequence generated before enrolment; the word randomised is not used.
Symptoms newly rated moderate/severe at follow-up were observed but not attributed to LIFU by the authors.
